_note: English and German renderings of group names published only in Ukrainian. Shown beneath the original, never instead of it: the Ukrainian title is the group's own name and stays primary. Keyed by group id. Add a language by adding a key.
_places_note: Place names are different from group names: a city is a label, not something anyone chose, and leaving one in Cyrillic beside an English country name reads as an oversight rather than as respect. These replace the value outright. Keyed by the exact string in the city column.
